ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The boundary of the shaded feasible region in the diagram includes two oblique straight lines and one vertical straight line; reading from the coordinate grid, this vertical boundary is located at x=1. Then reason: the boundary line of the inequality x-y+3≥0 is y=x+3, the boundary line of the inequality x+y+1≥0 is y=-x-1, and the boundary line of the inequality x≤k is x=k. In the diagram, the vertical boundary corresponding to x≤k is x=k, and its x-coordinate reading is 1, so k=1.

From the image, identify the vertical boundary line of the shaded feasible region; read its x-coordinate from the grid/axis labels. Since the boundary corresponding to x≤k is exactly the vertical line x=k, the x-coordinate read from the graph is k, giving k=1.
